The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Semantic role analysis of the sentence "The firefighter raced into the burning building to rescue the trapped occupants, demonstrating true heroism":

- **The firefighter**: Agent (the one performing the action of racing)
- **raced**: Verb (the main action)
- **into the burning building**: Location/Goal (the direction and destination of the racing)
- **to rescue the trapped occupants**: Purpose (the reason for racing)
  - **to rescue**: Purpose verb
  - **the trapped occupants**: Patient/Theme (the entity being rescued)
- **demonstrating true heroism**: Manner/Result (describing the nature or consequence of the action)
  - **demonstrating**: Participle verb
  - **true heroism**: Theme (what is being demonstrated)
